args.prompt: A cute smiling RESCUE CLOUD: a fluffy pink-white cloud with a happy face, closed happy eyes, blush cheeks and a small smile, small cloud arms waving. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, same size, plenty of empty space: (1)-(4) gently bobbing and puffing with a waving arm; (5)-(6) arriving, stretched and flying, motion puffs trailing; (7)-(8) giving a thumbs up with a wink. Each cloud is about 22 percent of the image height. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no text, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
